# The C&O Canal, structured as data.

A reproducible, source-aware dataset for exploring the places and geography of
the 184.5-mile Chesapeake & Ohio Canal corridor.

[Explore the canal](explore.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Get the data](data.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

towpath = FileAttachment("data/public/towpath.geojson").json()
features = FileAttachment("data/public/json/features.json").json()

corridorMap = {
  const coords = towpath.features[0].geometry.coordinates;
  const points = features.features;
  const chartWidth = Math.max(width, 680);
  const chartHeight = Math.max(310, chartWidth * 0.39);
  const margin = 38;
  const longitudes = coords.map(d => d[0]);
  const latitudes = coords.map(d => d[1]);
  const minX = Math.min(...longitudes), maxX = Math.max(...longitudes);
  const minY = Math.min(...latitudes), maxY = Math.max(...latitudes);
  const scale = Math.min(
    (chartWidth - margin * 2) / (maxX - minX),
    (chartHeight - margin * 2) / (maxY - minY)
  );
  const x = lon => margin + (lon - minX) * scale;
  const y = lat => chartHeight - margin - (lat - minY) * scale;
  const ns = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const svg = document.createElementNS(ns, "svg");
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${chartWidth} ${chartHeight}`);
  svg.setAttribute("role", "img");
  svg.setAttribute("aria-label", "Map of the C&O Canal from Georgetown to Cumberland with locks and access points");
  svg.classList.add("corridor-map");
  const path = document.createElementNS(ns, "path");
  path.setAttribute("d", coords.map((d, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"}${x(d[0]).toFixed(2)},${y(d[1]).toFixed(2)}`).join(" "));
  path.setAttribute("class", "towpath-line");
  svg.append(path);
  for (const point of points.filter(d => ["access_point", "lock"].includes(d.feature_type))) {
    const marker = document.createElementNS(ns, "circle");
    marker.setAttribute("cx", x(point.longitude));
    marker.setAttribute("cy", y(point.latitude));
    marker.setAttribute("r", point.feature_type === "access_point" ? 2.1 : 1.35);
    marker.setAttribute("class", `map-marker ${point.feature_type}`);
    const title = document.createElementNS(ns, "title");
    title.textContent = `${point.name} · mile ${point.mile}`;
    marker.append(title);
    svg.append(marker);
  }
  for (const [label, coord, anchor] of [
    ["Georgetown · MP 0", coords[0], "end"],
    ["Cumberland · MP 184.5", coords[coords.length - 1], "start"]
  ]) {
    const text = document.createElementNS(ns, "text");
    text.setAttribute("x", x(coord[0]));
    text.setAttribute("y", y(coord[1]) - 12);
    text.setAttribute("text-anchor", anchor);
    text.textContent = label;
    svg.append(text);
  }
  return svg;
}
```

Canawler turns curated public references into stable CSV, JSON, and GeoJSON. The
pipeline records where facts came from, validates the important assumptions, and
rebuilds without personal activity data.
